testmaster.name: TestMaster Suite (eval playbook, from the SaaS dataset's own calls)
testmaster.productDescription: TestMaster Suite: test automation for software teams. Scriptless test automation, cross-platform testing, a real-time analytics dashboard, and integration with CI/CD tools. Price: $5,000 a month. Includes onboarding resources, hands-on training sessions and an integration support team.
testmaster.idealCustomer: Software teams slowed down by manual testing, tight release deadlines and poor visibility into test coverage.

objections.objection: Too expensive / $5,000 a month is a lot
objections.good_response: Acknowledge it, then compare it to what manual testing costs them today in time and missed deadlines. There are no discounts or cheaper tiers.

objections.objection: Will it integrate with our current setup?
objections.good_response: It integrates with CI/CD tools, and the integration support team helps; ask what their setup is before promising anything more specific.

objections.objection: My team doesn't handle change well
objections.good_response: Mention the onboarding resources and hands-on training, and ask what went wrong with past tool changes.

testmaster.toneNotes: Casual and friendly, like the calls themselves. Short sentences.

nexiv.name: Nexiv Solutions (eval playbook, from the gwenshap dataset's own calls)
nexiv.productDescription: Nexiv Solutions: a unified, cloud-based platform that integrates a company's existing systems, centralises customer and operational data, and adds project tracking and real-time reporting. Implementation follows a migration plan that does setup and testing before go-live, with dedicated onboarding specialists and training.
nexiv.idealCustomer: Mid-sized companies with disconnected tools, data silos, downtime during system changes, and slow manual reporting.

objections.objection: We're on a tight budget / what does it cost?
objections.good_response: Pricing depends on the package and the size of the operation; don't quote a number. Ask the scoping questions needed for a detailed quote and connect cost to the time and downtime they lose today.

objections.objection: We worry about downtime during the switch
objections.good_response: Explain the migration plan (setup and testing before go-live) and the onboarding specialists, then ask what went wrong in past transitions.
